scenario.title: The Buried Bell
scenario.premise: Kael works out of a relic-hunters' guild hall called the Buried Bell, taking whatever the board offers and coming home to sell what he pried loose before the next job calls him out again.

scene.title: The Buried Bell
scene.question: The Bell owes the town its rent at the thaw, and Orsa's ledger shows Kael's finds have not yet covered his seat at the long table.
scene.situation: The guild hall smells of tallow and old paper, its long table scarred by a hundred maps traced and retraced. Orsa Vane stands behind the board with a ledger open, and Castor Wren nurses a drink at the corner of the table, one boot up on the bench where his other leg should be.
scene.secret: Castor Wren sold his map to the Sealed Cairn twice — once to Orsa for the board, once to the hooded stranger by the door, who is waiting to see who takes the job so he can follow them out.

world.source: A relic-hunters' guild hall, a board of jobs, and whatever Kael can pry loose from what the world sealed away.

board.title: The Sealed Cairn
board.pitch: A hill cairn out past the millpond, never opened — whatever is inside, it pays double just to look.

board.title: The Drowned Archive
board.pitch: An old archive gone under the river ice last winter, records worth more than the silver that will pay for them.

board.title: The Widow's Debt
board.pitch: A widow at the edge of town wants something of her husband's back from wherever he sold it — she pays in his old maps.

orsa-vane.name: Orsa Vane
orsa-vane.brief: Keeper of the Buried Bell's board; she knows every crew working the buried city and what each of them owes.
orsa-vane.goal: Keep the hall's name clean of the crews who take shortcuts
orsa-vane.motive: She built this guild from nothing and will not watch it rot

castor-wren.name: Castor Wren
castor-wren.brief: A retired relic-hunter who trades old rumours for drinks at the long table; the road took his leg two years back.
castor-wren.goal: Hear the story before anyone else at the table does
castor-wren.motive: The road already took his leg; the least it owes him is the gossip

hooded-stranger.name: a hooded stranger
hooded-stranger.brief: Sits by the door with a drink he has not touched, watching the board and who takes what off it.

player.name: Kael
player.brief: A scarred relic-hunter who comes wherever something old lies sealed, and does not leave it shut.
player.goal: Find what has been sealed away, and open it
player.motive: Whatever was worth sealing is worth more unsealed
